_readme: Long-form descriptions written by the property's source (Jeff Tucker, raindancelandpartners.com), used on the listing page instead of the auto-generated description. Keyed by property id. The page only uses an entry when its apn matches the record's apn. Edits made when importing: removed fishing/boating/wildlife and animal-attraction mentions, prices and contact calls to action, headlines, and structured key/value blocks; replaced dashes. Text is otherwise his. Not used: 114 (his page text is pasted from a Colorado listing) and 122 (his page repeats the 121 text, including 121's street).

paragraphs: Discover the opportunity to own a spacious 2.28-acre parcel in the peaceful Yucca Valley Ranchos area of Mohave County, Arizona. This flat, easy-to-build lot offers scenic wide-open plains at an elevation between 1,666 and 1,675 feet, perfect for creating your ideal rural retreat or permanent residence. Zoned for agricultural residential use, the property allows for single-family homes, mobile homes (post-1976 models with approved skirting), and RV camping with some restrictions. The parcel is accessible via W Saguaro Drive, a county-maintained dirt road, and sits conveniently close to US Highway 40 and Route 95, providing reasonable access to major cities like Las Vegas, Phoenix, and Flagstaff.

Enjoy nearby attractions such as the iconic London Bridge, Big Bend of the Colorado State Recreation Area, and several local parks for outdoor recreation. Utilities are off-grid: water can be sourced by well or hauled in, septic systems are required, and electricity can be generated via solar, wind, or generators. There are no HOA fees, and property taxes are low, making this parcel an affordable and flexible option for your desert living dreams. Whether you're looking for a quiet getaway, a place to camp with your RV, or a long-term investment, this lot offers a fantastic foundation in a growing and scenic region. Ownership comes with no hidden costs or recurring dues.

Own 2.28 acres of freedom in Mohave County, Arizona, nestled in the tranquil Yucca Valley Ranchos subdivision. This flat, desert parcel offers wide-open views, peaceful solitude, and a prime location off W Palo Verde Dr, just a short drive from US Highway 40 and Route 95. Ideal for a future home, off-grid retreat, or recreational basecamp, this land is zoned Agricultural Residential, allowing for site-built homes, mobile homes (1976 or newer with skirting), and limited RV use. With no HOA restrictions, you'll have the flexibility to create your own setup using solar, wind, or generator power. Haul or drill your own water and install a septic system to complete your setup.

This property is perfectly positioned between adventure and convenience, close to Lake Havasu City, Kingman, Bullhead City, and even Las Vegas. Nearby attractions include the iconic London Bridge, Big Bend of the Colorado State Recreation Area, and Bullhead City Community Park. Annual taxes are just $33.18, and there are no back taxes or liens. Whether you're looking to hold land as an investment or put it to personal use, this affordable parcel offers unbeatable value with minimal overhead. Ownership includes zero surprise fees or ongoing dues.
This 0.23-acre residential lot in Putnam County, Florida offers a great opportunity to build a single-family home in a quiet, established area of the Paradise Lakes Subdivision near Georgetown.

The property is flat and lightly treed, sitting at a low elevation of around 12 to 13 feet, with county-maintained dirt road access in place. Zoned Residential Single Family (R-2), the lot allows for a site-built home or a mobile home, giving you flexibility in how you choose to use the land. With no HOA, extremely low annual property taxes of approximately $28, and easy access to US Highway 17 and State Road 100, this property keeps long-term ownership simple and affordable.

The location puts you within reach of major Florida cities including Gainesville, Ocala, Orlando, Jacksonville, and Tampa, while still enjoying a more relaxed, rural setting. Nearby attractions such as Ravine Gardens State Park, Tuscawilla Park, and world-famous Orlando theme parks add recreational appeal for full-time living or future resale value. Utilities are straightforward to set up, with electric service available through Florida Power & Light, septic installation permitted, and well or cistern options for water. Offered with flexible owner financing or a discounted cash price, this Georgetown lot is a solid option for buyers looking for an affordable Florida homesite with long-term potential.

Tucked away in the quiet St. Johns Riverside Estates, Hoot Owl Ridge 3rd Addition, this 0.26-acre lot at 203 Mallard Road in Satsuma, Florida offers a unique opportunity for buyers who appreciate Florida's natural riverfront environment. Surrounded by mature trees and flat terrain, the property sits in an area known for its close connection to the St. Johns River, with Lake Myra running through the property and its beautiful wetlands ecosystem. For the right buyer who understands flood-zone living, this location can be ideal for building a raised home or mobile home and enjoying a peaceful setting with fresh air and quiet surroundings.

With Single-Family Residential (R-2) zoning, you can build a home or place a mobile home (minimum 400 sq ft once properly installed). The property has county-maintained dirt road access, low annual taxes of about $74.94, and easy access to nearby highways including US-17 and Route 100, connecting you to Palatka, Keystone Heights, and Ocala. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate being near local attractions such as Ravine Gardens State Park and the scenic riverfront areas along the St. Johns River.
Tucked away in the peaceful community of Interlachen, this beautiful 0.24-acre wooded homesite offers the perfect blend of privacy, natural beauty, and convenience.
Located on paved Dickens Street just north of State Road 20, the property features mature trees, lush native vegetation, and level topography ideal for building after clearing and utility connection.

Surrounded by Florida's scenic lakes, forests, and outdoor recreation, this property is perfect for those seeking a quiet retreat while still remaining close to modern conveniences. Interlachen is known for its laid-back atmosphere and easy access to nearby parks and nature preserves.

The property is conveniently situated approximately 20 minutes from Palatka, about 45 minutes from Gainesville, and just over an hour from both St. Augustine and Daytona Beach. Jacksonville International Airport and Orlando-area attractions are also within comfortable driving distance, making this an ideal location for a future homesite, weekend getaway, or long-term land investment.
With paved road access, nearby utility infrastructure, and a peaceful natural setting, this lot offers outstanding potential in one of North Central Florida's growing rural communities.
Escape to the quiet beauty of Putnam County with this 0.22-acre wooded homesite located on Smokey Avenue in the growing Interlachen area.
Surrounded by mature trees and natural Florida landscape, this property offers privacy, peaceful surroundings, and excellent potential for a future homesite, getaway cabin, or land investment.

The lot features level terrain with a gentle slope, nearby utility access, and a natural wooded setting ready to be transformed after clearing. A neighboring established homesite to the north adds to the appeal while still maintaining the area's tranquil rural atmosphere.

Conveniently located near State Road 20, this property provides easy access to nearby towns and outdoor recreation. Enjoy hiking and exploring the many lakes and nature areas that make Putnam County a hidden gem for outdoor enthusiasts. The property is approximately 25 minutes from Palatka, 45 minutes from Gainesville, and within reach of St. Augustine, Daytona Beach, and Orlando for beaches, entertainment, and major airports.

Whether you're looking to build now or invest for the future, this affordable Florida lot offers a peaceful setting with plenty of potential in an area known for its natural beauty and relaxed lifestyle.
